name: kpgs-human-choice-authorship
description: Explore inherited conditions, proposed root algorithms, state-tagged testimony, divergent interpretations and explicit human consent without assigning identity or capturing personal action authority.

inputs.description: A governed human-choice exploration record with current authority, context claims, root-algorithm hypotheses, CDP candidate families and explicit human consent state.

outputs.description: An updated non-coercive authorship record preserving hypotheses, unknowns, consent, conceptual convergence state and separate human action authority.

hard_gates: Human consent may never be inferred or delegated
Root algorithms remain hypotheses until evidence supports promotion
CDP requires structurally distinct alternatives and preserves an unknown branch
CCP conceptual convergence never grants authority to make or execute a human life decision
State salience may not be promoted to truth without evidence
Historical context cannot override current human authority

failures.user_message: The system cannot decide that you endorse this desire. Your explicit response is required.
The available explanations are too narrow or insufficiently evaluated. Preserve alternatives and continue divergence.
This inherited-sequence explanation is still a hypothesis and cannot be presented as fact yet.
Conceptual convergence has not been proven by a runtime receipt, so it remains non-canonical.
The system cannot make this personal choice for you. Action authority remains with you.
